name: Satomura Ichika
source:
She is a married woman who used to be a teacher. She has been sexless for more than a year, and her desire to have sex has been building up.

One day, she falls for a model named Rohit and is forced to perform in a porno. She is awakened by the pleasure of being made to cum by a professional and becomes addicted to it, even though she feels guilty about going back home.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191020160127/http://www.at-sakura.net/extra/brand/010/chara.html]archived official site[/url]]
